rows.name: VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE
rows.description: Target device of vLLM, supporting [cuda (by default), rocm, cpu]

rows.name: VLLM_MAIN_CUDA_VERSION
rows.description: Main CUDA version of vLLM. This follows PyTorch but can be overridden.

rows.name: VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION
rows.description: Controls PyTorch float32 matmul precision mode within vLLM workers. Valid options mirror torch.set_float32_matmul_precision

rows.name: VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT
rows.description: Enable batch-invariant mode: deterministic results regardless of batch composition. Requires NVIDIA GPU with compute capability >= 9.0.

rows.name: VLLM_TRITON_USE_TD
rows.description: Use tensor descriptors for Q/K/V loads and output stores in the Triton unified-attention kernel. Enables HW 2D block reads on Intel XPU; the non-TD branch is dead-code-eliminated at Triton compile time so other platforms see no overhead. Tri-state override: unset (default) lets the `triton_attn` backend auto-select per platform (currently auto-enabled on …

rows.name: VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK
rows.description: If set, enable GPU<->CPU synchronization checking around the worker's `execute_model` and `sample_tokens` calls, via PyTorch's sync debug mode plus wrappers flagging `non_blocking` CPU<->CUDA copies that silently block the host (CPU tensors that are not pinned or not densely laid out). Valid values are "warn" (warn on each sync) or "error" (raise on sync). …

rows.name: MAX_JOBS
rows.description: Maximum number of compilation jobs to run in parallel. By default this is the number of CPUs

rows.name: NVCC_THREADS
rows.description: Number of threads to use for nvcc By default this is 1. If set, `MAX_JOBS` will be reduced to avoid oversubscribing the CPU.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED
rows.description: If set, vllm will use precompiled native binaries (*.so and vllm-rs).

rows.name: VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED_RUST
rows.description: If set, vllm will use the precompiled Rust frontend binary (vllm-rs).

rows.name: VLLM_SKIP_PRECOMPILED_VERSION_SUFFIX
rows.description: If set, skip adding +precompiled suffix to version string

rows.name: VLLM_DOCKER_BUILD_CONTEXT
rows.description: Used to mark that setup.py is running in a Docker build context, in order to force the use of precompiled binaries.

rows.name: VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT
rows.description: Build provenance metadata embedded in official vllm-openai images. Set via Docker ENV at image build time; informational only.

rows.name: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE
rows.description: CMake build type If not set, defaults to "Debug" or "RelWithDebInfo" Available options: "Debug", "Release", "RelWithDebInfo"

rows.name: VERBOSE
rows.description: If set, vllm will print verbose logs during installation

rows.name: VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT
rows.description: Root directory for vLLM configuration files Defaults to `~/.config/vllm` unless `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set Note that this not only affects how vllm finds its configuration files during runtime, but also affects how vllm installs its configuration files during **installation**.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_SLEEP_MEM_CHUNK_SIZE
rows.description: flag to control the chunk size (in MB) for sleeping memory allocations under ROCm

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_CUSTOM_AR
rows.description: Use AITER's CustomAllreduce as the custom-allreduce backend inside vLLM's CudaCommunicator on ROCm. Also enables AITER AG/RS for DP communication.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_MOE_REDUCE_DTYPE
rows.description: Muse Spark on ROCm: dtype of the TP reduction before the post-expert norm.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR
rows.description: use aiter linear op if aiter ops are enabled The following list of related ops - scaled_mm (per-tensor / rowwise) - use aiter tuned gemms for unquantized gemms

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE
rows.description: Whether to use aiter moe ops. By default is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_SITUV2
rows.description: Activation dtype for the Kimi-K3 SiTU MXFP4 MoE (AITER FlyDSL SiTUv2): auto (= a4w4), a4w4, a8w4 or a16w4. Legacy 1/0 mean a4w4/a16w4.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4
rows.description: Opt-in switch for a4w4 (FP4 activation) MoE on DeepSeek V4.1, AITER MXFP4 backend. Default is a8w4 (FP8); set to "1" to enable a4w4 ("true" is not accepted -- only "0"/"1"). Raises if set for other models.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MOE_DISPATCH_POLICY
rows.description: MoE sorting dispatch policy for AITER fused MoE kernels. 0 = auto (default): single-pass for small batches, multi-pass for large batches 1 = always single-pass: one kernel launch, no workspace, may be preferred for low-concurrency decode workloads 2 = always multi-pass: can be faster for MoE-heavy models (e.g., +2-5% on Qwen3-Next, +1.5% on DeepSeek-V3 at …

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM
rows.description: use aiter rms norm op if aiter ops are enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA
rows.description: Whether to use aiter mla ops. By default is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY
rows.description: Kernel for causal multi-token (spec-decode) verify steps under decode context parallelism: "asm" uses AITER's round-robin ASM decode (gfx950), "segmented" the Triton segmented MLA path. "auto" (default) takes "asm" wherever it can serve the shape and "segmented" otherwise.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_ASM_PADDING
rows.description: Small-head (<16) AITER MLA decode kernel selection. Small head counts (e.g. Kimi-K3: 12 heads/rank at TP8, 6 at TP16) can decode either through the Gluon small-head kernel or through the padded persistent-scheduling (PS) ASM kernel. "auto" (default) keeps Gluon for head counts that divide 16 where a Gluon build exists (gfx950/CDNA4) and otherwise uses the …

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA
rows.description: Whether to use aiter mha ops. By default is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA
rows.description: Whether sparse MLA prefill and decode run on aiter's Triton kernel, which reads the KV cache as stored (bf16 or fp8, paged or flat). Used by the ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE backend (DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5.x) and DeepSeek V4 / V4.1. gfx950 only. By default is disabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_ROPE
rows.description: Whether to use aiter rope. By default is disabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM
rows.description: Whether to use aiter triton fp8 bmm kernel for MLA kv_b_proj. By default is disabled: it re-quantizes the projection weights online, regardless of the precision the checkpoint asked for.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4BMM
rows.description: Whether to use aiter triton fp4 bmm kernel for MLA kv_b_proj. By default is disabled, for the same reason as the fp8 variant above.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION
rows.description: Use AITER triton unified attention for V1 attention

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS
rows.description: Whether to use aiter fusion shared experts ops. By default is disabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_GEMM
rows.description: Whether to use aiter triton kernels for gemm ops. By default is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM
rows.description: use rocm skinny gemms

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING
rows.description: Pad the fp8 weights to 256 bytes for ROCm

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_MOE_PADDING
rows.description: Pad the weights for the moe kernel

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT
rows.description: Whether to use the shuffled kv cache layout

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION
rows.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards Choice of quantization level: FP, INT8, INT6, INT4, INT3 or NONE Recommended for large models to get allreduce

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16
rows.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards Due to the lack of the bfloat16 asm instruction, bfloat16 kernels are slower than fp16, If environment variable is set to 1, the input is converted to fp16

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB
rows.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards. Controls the maximum allowed number of data bytes(MB) for custom quick allreduce communication. Default: 2048 MB. Data exceeding this size will use either custom allreduce or RCCL communication.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MIN_SIZE_BYTES_MB
rows.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards. Controls the minimum allowed number of data bytes(MB) required to use custom quick allreduce communication. If unset, use the built-in threshold table.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION_MIN_SIZE_KB
rows.description: Controls the minimum tensor size (KB, where 1 KB = 1024 bytes) required to use the configured QuickReduce codec. Smaller tensors use FP QuickReduce. This does not affect QuickReduce eligibility.

rows.name: VLLM_ROCM_FP8_MFMA_PAGE_ATTN
rows.description: If set, use the fp8 mfma in rocm paged attention.

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE
rows.description: (CPU backend only) CPU key-value cache space. default is None and will be set as 4 GB

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND
rows.description: (CPU backend only) CPU core ids bound by OpenMP threads, e.g., "0-31", "0,1,2", "0-31,33". CPU cores of different ranks are separated by '|'.

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_NUM_OF_RESERVED_CPU
rows.description: (CPU backend only) CPU cores not used by OMP threads . Those CPU cores will not be used by OMP threads of a rank.

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_CI_ENV
rows.description: (CPU backend only) whether vLLM is running in a CI environment.

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_ATTN_SPLIT_KV
rows.description: (CPU backend only) whether to enable attention spilt KV.

rows.name: VLLM_ZENTORCH_WEIGHT_PREPACK
rows.description: (Zen CPU backend) eagerly prepack weights into ZenDNN blocked layout at model load time. Eliminates per-inference layout conversion overhead.

rows.name: VLLM_CPU_INT4_W4A8
rows.description: (CPU backend only) whether to use SGLang INT4 W4A8 kernels for AWQ, and on Zen CPUs whether to serve int4 checkpoints as DA8W4 rather than W4A16.

rows.name: VLLM_XPU_PP_MICROBATCH
rows.description: Using a flag to control microbatch on XPU device, users on XPU device can decide to disable it when they needed.

rows.name: VLLM_XPU_FORCE_N_CONTIG_WEIGHT
rows.description: Force N-contiguous weight layout for all XPU unquantized linears.

rows.name: VLLM_XPU_USE_SAMPLER_KERNEL
rows.description: whether use xpu specific sample kernel

rows.name: VLLM_XPU_INC_WNA16_BACKEND
rows.description: Kernel backend for INC weight-only intN (WNA16) linear layers on XPU. "auto" keeps the default preference order (ARK when importable, else the oneDNN w4a16 path). "ark" forces the auto_round_kernel backend, "w4a16" forces oneDNN int4_gemm_w4a16, and "w4a8" additionally quantizes activations to per-token int8 (int4_gemm_w4a8) for large token counts. The two …

rows.name: VLLM_XLA_CACHE_PATH
rows.description: Path to the XLA persistent cache directory. Only used for XLA devices such as TPUs.

rows.name: VLLM_XLA_CHECK_RECOMPILATION
rows.description: If set, assert on XLA recompilation after each execution step.

rows.name: VLLM_XLA_USE_SPMD
rows.description: Enable SPMD mode for TPU backend.

rows.name: VLLM_TPU_USING_PATHWAYS
rows.description: Whether using Pathways

rows.name: VLLM_DEBUG_LOG_API_SERVER_RESPONSE
rows.description: Whether to log responses from API Server for debugging

rows.name: VLLM_USAGE_STATS_SERVER
rows.description: Usage stats collection

rows.name: VLLM_CONFIGURE_LOGGING
rows.description: Logging configuration If set to 0, vllm will not configure logging If set to 1, vllm will configure logging using the default configuration or the configuration file specified by VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH

rows.name: VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL
rows.description: this is used for configuring the default logging level

rows.name: VLLM_LOGGING_STREAM
rows.description: this is used for configuring the default logging stream

rows.name: VLLM_LOGGING_PREFIX
rows.description: if set, VLLM_LOGGING_PREFIX will be prepended to all log messages

rows.name: VLLM_LOGGING_COLOR
rows.description: Controls colored logging output. Options: "auto" (default, colors when terminal), "1" (always use colors), "0" (never use colors)

rows.name: NO_COLOR
rows.description: Standard unix flag for disabling ANSI color codes

rows.name: FORCE_COLOR
rows.description: De-facto standard flag for forcing ANSI color codes (e.g. non-tty case)

rows.name: VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL
rows.description: If set, vllm will log stats at this interval in seconds If not set, vllm will log stats every 10 seconds.

rows.name: VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION
rows.description: Trace function calls If set to 1, vllm will trace function calls Useful for debugging

rows.name: VLLM_LOG_MODEL_INSPECTION
rows.description: Log model inspection after loading. If enabled, logs a transformers-style hierarchical view of the model with quantization methods and attention backends.

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLE_LOG_LOGO
rows.description: Disable logging of vLLM logo at server startup time.

rows.name: VLLM_REQUEST_BODY_LOG_LEVEL
rows.description: Logging level for request JSON body.

rows.name: VLLM_PATTERN_MATCH_DEBUG
rows.description: Debug pattern matching inside custom passes. Should be set to the fx.Node name (e.g. 'getitem_34' or 'scaled_mm_3').

rows.name: VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH
rows.description: Dump fx graphs to the given directory. It will override CompilationConfig.debug_dump_path if set.

rows.name: VLLM_COMPUTE_NANS_IN_LOGITS
rows.description: Enable checking whether the generated logits contain NaNs, indicating corrupted output. Useful for debugging low level bugs or bad hardware but it may add compute overhead.

rows.name: VLLM_RAISE_ON_LOGIT_NANS
rows.description: Raise an exception when generated logits contain NaNs. Enabling this also enables the NaN computation required to detect them.

rows.name: VLLM_CUSTOM_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING
rows.description: Add optional custom scopes for profiling, disable to avoid overheads

rows.name: VLLM_NVTX_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING
rows.description: Add optional nvtx scopes for profiling, disable to avoid overheads

rows.name: VLLM_GC_DEBUG
rows.description: GC debug config - VLLM_GC_DEBUG=0: disable GC debugger - VLLM_GC_DEBUG=1: enable GC debugger with gc.collect elpased times - VLLM_GC_DEBUG='{"top_objects":5}': enable GC debugger with top 5 collected objects

rows.name: VLLM_DEBUG_WORKSPACE
rows.description: Debug workspace allocations. logging of workspace resize operations.

rows.name: VLLM_DEBUG_MFU_METRICS
rows.description: Debug logging for --enable-mfu-metrics

rows.name: VLLM_USE_STANDALONE_COMPILE
rows.description: Feature flag to enable/disable Inductor standalone compile. In torch <= 2.7 we ignore this flag; in torch >= 2.9 this is enabled by default.

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_PREGRAD_PASSES
rows.description: Inductor's pre-grad passes don't do anything for vLLM. The pre-grad passes get run even on cache-hit and negatively impact vllm cold compile times by O(1s) Can remove this after the following issue gets fixed TODO(luka): maybe_inplace requires this https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/174502

rows.name: VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH
rows.description: Experimental: breakable cudagraph does not rely on torch.compile

rows.name: VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE
rows.description: Feature flag to enable/disable AOT compilation. This will ensure compilation is done in warmup phase and the compilation will be reused in subsequent calls.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_BYTECODE_HOOK
rows.description: Feature flag to enable/disable bytecode in TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper.

rows.name: VLLM_FORCE_AOT_LOAD
rows.description: Force vllm to always load AOT compiled models from disk. Failure to load will result in a hard error when this is enabled. Will be ignored when VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE is disabled.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT
rows.description: Enable loading compiled models directly from cached standalone compile artifacts without re-splitting graph modules. This reduces overhead during model loading by using reconstruct_serializable_fn_from_mega_artifact.

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_CUDAGRAPH_GC
rows.description: Controls garbage collection during CUDA graph capture. If set to 0 (default), enables GC freezing to speed up capture time. If set to 1, allows GC to run during capture.

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_INDUCTOR_MAX_AUTOTUNE
rows.description: Enable max_autotune & coordinate_descent_tuning in inductor_config to compile static shapes passed from compile_sizes in compilation_config If set to 1, enable max_autotune; By default, this is enabled (1)

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_INDUCTOR_COORDINATE_DESCENT_TUNING
rows.description: If set to 1, enable coordinate_descent_tuning; By default, this is enabled (1)

rows.name: VLLM_COMPILE_CACHE_SAVE_FORMAT
rows.description: Format for saving torch.compile cache artifacts - "binary": saves as binary file Safe for multiple vllm serve processes accessing the same torch compile cache. - "unpacked": saves as directory structure (for inspection/debugging) NOT multiprocess safe - race conditions may occur with multiple processes. Allows viewing and setting breakpoints in Inductor's …

rows.name: VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS
rows.description: If set to 1, enable CUDA graph memory estimation during memory profiling. This profiles CUDA graph memory usage to provide more accurate KV cache memory allocation. Enabled by default as of v0.21.0

rows.name: VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST
rows.description: IP address used for NIXL handshake between remote agents.

rows.name: VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT
rows.description: Port used for NIXL handshake between remote agents.

rows.name: VLLM_P2P_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST
rows.description: Address the P2P KV-offload control socket binds to. Defaults to ``localhost`` (loopback only); must be set to the node IP for cross-host P2P so remote peers can reach the socket.

rows.name: VLLM_P2P_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT
rows.description: Port the P2P KV-offload control socket binds to.

rows.name: VLLM_P2P_MAX_PEERS
rows.description: Maximum number of concurrent P2P peer sessions. Limits ZMQ socket consumption to prevent denial-of-service via unbounded peer creation from client-supplied kv_transfer_params. Default: 128.

rows.name: VLLM_P2P_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_S
rows.description: Seconds to wait for a P2P peer handshake to complete (connected but not yet ready). Sessions exceeding this deadline are reaped. Prevents never-responding peers from accumulating indefinitely.

rows.name: VLLM_P2P_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S
rows.description: Seconds a P2P session may remain idle (no pending work, no messages) before it is eligible for eviction. Idle eviction runs only when remaining peer slots are within 8 of VLLM_P2P_MAX_PEERS. Default: 300. Set to 0 to disable.

rows.name: VLLM_EC_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST
rows.description: IP address used for the EC connector's ZMQ side channel (producer ROUTER bind, consumer DEALER dial).

rows.name: VLLM_EC_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT
rows.description: Port for the EC connector's ZMQ side channel; advertised to peers via `ec_transfer_params.peer_port` on the producer's response.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Per-request timeout (seconds) when a prefiller worker registers with the Mooncake bootstrap server.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_BOOTSTRAP_PORT
rows.description: Port used for Mooncake handshake between remote agents.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_STORE_TIER_LOG
rows.description: Log per-batch memory/disk tier breakdown on external GETs.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS
rows.description: Number of parallel KV-load receive threads per worker rank. Lets the per-request control overhead (Python prep + master key lookup) of one request overlap with the RDMA transfer of another, keeping the transfer engine's queue pairs busy. Helps when that overhead is significant or per-request batches are too small to saturate the link on their own.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_DISK_STAGING_USABLE_RATIO
rows.description: Fraction of the owner's DirectIO staging buffer to fill per GET batch.

rows.name: MOONCAKE_PREFERRED_SEGMENT
rows.description: Pin this rank to a specific owner segment ("host:port").

rows.name: MOONCAKE_REQUESTER_LOCAL_HOSTNAME
rows.description: Override the hostname the rank registers as a Mooncake requester.

rows.name: VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Timeout (in seconds) for MooncakeConnector in PD disaggregated setup.

rows.name: VLLM_KV_EVENTS_USE_INT_BLOCK_HASHES
rows.description: Represent block hashes in KV cache events as 64-bit integers instead of raw bytes. Defaults to True for backward compatibility.

rows.name: VLLM_OBJECT_STORAGE_SHM_BUFFER_NAME
rows.description: Name of the shared memory buffer used for object storage. Only effective when mm_config.mm_processor_cache_type == "shm". Automatically generates a unique UUID-based name per process tree if not explicitly set.

rows.name: VLLM_KV_OFFLOAD_MAX_BATCH_DESCRIPTORS
rows.description: Max descriptors per CPU-KV-offload batch-memcpy call. 0 = platform default (ROCm chunks at 8192, since hipMemcpyBatchAsync faults above that on rocm 7.14/7.15 when batch copy is optimized; CUDA uncapped). Set >0 to override.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD
rows.description: Enable simple KV offload.

rows.name: VLLM_GPU_NIC_PCIE_MAPPING
rows.description: Comma-separated GPU_BDF=NIC_BDF pairs for RDMA NIC selection. Must be set together with VLLM_NIC_SELECTION_VARS.

rows.name: VLLM_NIC_SELECTION_VARS
rows.description: Comma-separated list of env vars to set from the GPU-NIC mapping. Each entry is VAR_NAME or VAR_NAME:<suffix> (suffix appended to RDMA device name). Must be set together with VLLM_GPU_NIC_PCIE_MAPPING.

rows.name: VLLM_HUMMING_MOE_GEMM_TYPE
rows.description: Whether to use indexed gemm for humming moe if 1, force use indexed gemm if 0, force use grouped gemm if None, choose better gemm type automatically

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEPLL_NVFP4_DISPATCH
rows.description: Whether to use DeepEPLL kernels for NVFP4 quantization and dispatch method only supported on Blackwell GPUs and with https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/pull/341

rows.name: VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM
rows.description: Allow use of DeepGemm kernels for fused moe ops.

rows.name: VLLM_MOE_USE_DEEP_GEMM
rows.description: Allow use of DeepGemm specifically for MoE fused ops (overrides only MoE).

rows.name: VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM_E8M0
rows.description: Whether to use E8M0 scaling when DeepGEMM is used on Blackwell GPUs.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM_TMA_ALIGNED_SCALES
rows.description: Whether to create TMA-aligned scale tensor when DeepGEMM is used.

rows.name: VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP
rows.description: DeepGemm JITs the kernels on-demand. The warmup attempts to make DeepGemm JIT all the required kernels before model execution so there is no JIT'ing in the hot-path. However, this warmup increases the engine startup time by a couple of minutes. Available options: - "skip" : Skip warmup. - "full" : Warmup deepgemm by running all possible gemm shapes the …

rows.name: VLLM_USE_FUSED_MOE_GROUPED_TOPK
rows.description: Whether to use fused grouped_topk used for MoE expert selection.

rows.name: VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING
rows.description: Skip cudagraph/DP padding tokens in the MoE path by forcing their expert ids to -1 so the dispatch and experts drop them. Requires a MoE kernel that treats topk_id == -1 as a skip sentinel

rows.name: VLLM_STEP5_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT
rows.description: Step5 SP dense/shared MLPs: opt into TP-sharded weights with AG/RS instead of replicated weights and local-token computation.

rows.name: VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT
rows.description: Kimi-K3 only. Under sequence-parallel MoE the dense and shared-expert MLPs are replicated on every rank, so each rank streams the whole weight to serve its own token shard. Shard them across TP instead: the MLP then all-gathers the full token set, computes this rank's partial, and reduce-scatters (which both sums across TP and restores the sequence …

rows.name: VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16
rows.description: Force b12x FP4 MoE to use BF16 activations.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_INT4
rows.description: Allow use of FlashInfer MxInt4 MoE kernels for fused moe ops.

rows.name: VLLM_FLASHINFER_MOE_A2A_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE
rows.description: Transmit MoE all-to-all combine (expert-output) payloads in FP8 instead of BF16, halving NVLink traffic on the combine leg. Only takes effect when the installed FlashInfer MoeAlltoAll kernel supports it.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_EXPERT_FP4_MOE
rows.description: Control the maximum number of tokens per expert supported by the NVFP4 MoE CUTLASS Kernel. This value is used to create a buffer for the blockscale tensor of activations NVFP4 Quantization. This is used to prevent the kernel from running out of memory.

rows.name: VLLM_MOE_ROUTING_SIMULATION_STRATEGY
rows.description: MoE routing strategy selector. See `RoutingSimulator.get_available_strategies()` # for available strategies. Custom routing strategies can be registered by RoutingSimulator.register_strategy() Note: custom strategies may not produce correct model outputs

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_BUFFER_SIZE_MB
rows.description: The size in MB of the buffers (NVL and RDMA) used by DeepEP

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_HIGH_THROUGHPUT_FORCE_INTRA_NODE
rows.description: Force DeepEP to use intranode kernel for inter-node communication in high throughput mode. This is useful archive higher prefill throughput on system supports multi-node nvlink (e.g GB200).

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_LOW_LATENCY_USE_MNNVL
rows.description: Allow DeepEP to use MNNVL (multi-node nvlink) for internode_ll kernel, turn this for better latency on GB200 like system

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_V2_ALLOW_HYBRID_MODE
rows.description: DeepEP v2: use NVLink+RDMA hybrid communication across NVLink domains. * hybrid mode = multi-node RDMA * non hybrid mode = nvlink Set to 1 (the default) to allow DeepEP to autoselect hybrid vs non-hybrid. Set to 0 to disable hybrid mode.

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_V2_PREFER_OVERLAP
rows.description: DeepEP v2: use fewer SMs at slight throughput cost

rows.name: VLLM_DEEPEP_V2_ALLOW_MULTIPLE_REDUCTION
rows.description: DeepEP v2: trade precision for transfer size in combine

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM
rows.description: Disables parallel execution of shared_experts via separate cuda stream

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLE_DSV4_MEGAMOE_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSION
rows.description: Emergency rollback for the DeepSeek-V4 NVIDIA MegaMoE path. By default, DeepGEMM computes replicated FP8 shared experts in the same persistent SM100 kernel as the routed FP4 experts.

rows.name: VLLM_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Limits when we run shared_experts in a separate stream. We found out that for large batch sizes, the separate stream execution is not beneficial (most likely because of the input clone) TODO(alexm-redhat): Tune to be more dynamic based on GPU type

rows.name: VLLM_COHERE2_ATTN_MOE_DUAL_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Cohere2 MoE runs the MLP/MoE of its parallel blocks on a side CUDA stream, overlapping it with attention, for batches of at most this many tokens. Larger batches and piecewise CUDA graphs (prefill / mixed batches) run the MLP inline. Set to 0 to disable the dual stream.

rows.name: VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH
rows.description: Whether it is a scale up launch engine for elastic EP, Should only be set by EngineCoreClient.

rows.name: VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_DRAIN_REQUESTS
rows.description: Whether to wait for all requests to drain before sending the scaling command in elastic EP.

rows.name: CUDA_HOME
rows.description: path to cudatoolkit home directory, under which should be bin, include, and lib directories.

rows.name: VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH
rows.description: Path to the NCCL library file. It is needed because nccl>=2.19 brought by PyTorch contains a bug: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl/issues/1234

rows.name: LD_LIBRARY_PATH
rows.description: when `VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH` is not set, vllm will try to find the nccl library file in the locations specified by `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`

rows.name: VLLM_CUDART_SO_PATH
rows.description: In some system, find_loaded_library() may not work. So we allow users to specify the path through environment variable VLLM_CUDART_SO_PATH.

rows.name: VLLM_HAS_FLASHINFER_CUBIN
rows.description: If set, it means we pre-downloaded cubin files and flashinfer will read the cubin files directly.

rows.name: VLLM_NCCL_INCLUDE_PATH
rows.description: NCCL header path

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY
rows.description: Enable CUDA compatibility mode for datacenter GPUs with older driver versions than the CUDA toolkit major version of vLLM.

rows.name: VLLM_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY_PATH
rows.description: Path to the CUDA compatibility libraries when CUDA compatibility is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S
rows.description: Timeout in seconds for waiting for engine cores to become ready during startup. Default is 600 seconds (10 minutes).

rows.name: VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH
rows.description: If set, the OpenAI API server will stay alive even after the underlying AsyncLLMEngine errors and stops serving requests

rows.name: VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN
rows.description: If the env var VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN is set, it allows the user to specify a max sequence length greater than the max length derived from the model's config.json. To enable this, set VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1.

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING
rows.description: If set, enable multiprocessing in LLM for the V1 code path.

rows.name: VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE
rows.description: Controls the maximum number of requests to handle in a single asyncio task when processing per-token outputs in the V1 AsyncLLM interface. It is applicable when handling a high concurrency of streaming requests. Setting this too high can result in a higher variance of inter-message latencies. Setting it too low can negatively impact TTFT and overall …

rows.name: VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
rows.description: Timeout in seconds for execute_model RPC calls in multiprocessing executor (only applies when TP > 1).

rows.name: VLLM_WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
rows.description: Timeout in seconds for engine and worker process shutdown

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_STARTUP_PLAN
rows.description: Opt-in persistence of the startup plan. When enabled, each worker saves the memory-profiling result (the suggested --kv-cache-memory value and the free-memory baseline) under VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/startup_plan/, keyed by a hardware+config fingerprint, and later boots auto-apply it -- skipping memory profiling -- when the fingerprint matches and current free …

rows.name: VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER
rows.description: Flag to control the v2 model runner. If unset, use config defaults.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_SPINLOOP_EXT
rows.description: If set to 1, use Python spinloop extension to poll in a more efficient way when using the mp backend.

rows.name: VLLM_HOST_IP
rows.description: used in distributed environment to determine the ip address of the current node, when the node has multiple network interfaces. If you are using multi-node inference, you should set this differently on each node.

rows.name: VLLM_PORT
rows.description: used in distributed environment to manually set the communication port Note: if VLLM_PORT is set, and some code asks for multiple ports, the VLLM_PORT will be used as the first port, and the rest will be generated by incrementing the VLLM_PORT value.

rows.name: VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH
rows.description: path used for ipc when the frontend api server is running in multi-processing mode to communicate with the backend engine process.

rows.name: VLLM_RINGBUFFER_WARNING_INTERVAL
rows.description: Interval in seconds to log a warning message when the ring buffer is full

rows.name: LOCAL_RANK
rows.description: local rank of the process in the distributed setting, used to determine the GPU device id

rows.name: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
rows.description: used to control the visible devices in the distributed setting

rows.name: VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION
rows.description: Pipeline stage partition strategy

rows.name: VLLM_DISTRIBUTED_USE_SPLIT_GROUP
rows.description: When True, GroupCoordinator constructs its CPU/device subgroups via ``torch.distributed.split_group(backend=...)`` and ``init_distributed_environment`` initializes the default PG with mixed ``cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl`` backend + eager ``device_id`` binding.

rows.name: VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD
rows.description: Use dedicated multiprocess context for workers. Both spawn and fork work

rows.name: VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK
rows.description: We assume drivers can report p2p status correctly. If the program hangs when using custom allreduce, potantially caused by a bug in the driver (535 series), if might be helpful to set VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK=0 so that vLLM can verify if p2p is actually working. See …

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLE_PYNCCL
rows.description: Disable pynccl (using torch.distributed instead)

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_PER_WORKER_GPUS
rows.description: If set, vLLM will pick up the provided Flash Attention MLA Number of GPUs per worker in Ray, if it is set to be a fraction, it allows ray to schedule multiple actors on a single GPU, so that users can colocate other actors on the same GPUs as vLLM.

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_BUNDLE_INDICES
rows.description: Bundle indices for Ray, if it is set, it can control precisely which indices are used for the Ray bundle, for every worker. Format: comma-separated list of integers, e.g. "0,1,2,3"

rows.name: VLLM_DP_RANK
rows.description: Rank of the process in the data parallel setting

rows.name: VLLM_DP_RANK_LOCAL
rows.description: Rank of the process in the data parallel setting. Defaults to VLLM_DP_RANK when not set.

rows.name: VLLM_DP_SIZE
rows.description: World size of the data parallel setting

rows.name: VLLM_DP_MASTER_IP
rows.description: IP address of the master node in the data parallel setting

rows.name: VLLM_DP_MASTER_PORT
rows.description: Port of the master node in the data parallel setting

rows.name: VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS
rows.description: Randomize inputs during dummy runs when using Data Parallel

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_DP_PACK_STRATEGY
rows.description: Strategy to pack the data parallel ranks for Ray. Available options: - "fill": for DP master node, allocate exactly data-parallel-size-local DP ranks, for non-master nodes, allocate as many DP ranks as can fit; - "strict": allocate exactly data-parallel-size-local DP ranks to each picked node; - "span": Should be used only when a single DP rank requires …

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_DP_PLACEMENT_NODE_IPS
rows.description: Optional comma-separated list of node IPs that Ray data-parallel placement groups may use. When set, create_dp_placement_groups only considers these nodes (the DP master node is always included). This environment variable is ignored if data-parallel-backend is not Ray.

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VAR_PREFIXES_TO_COPY
rows.description: Comma-separated *additional* prefixes of env vars to copy from the driver to Ray workers. These are merged with the built-in defaults defined in ``vllm.ray.ray_env`` (VLLM_, etc.). Example: "MYLIB_,OTHER_"

rows.name: VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VARS_TO_COPY
rows.description: Comma-separated *additional* individual env var names to copy from the driver to Ray workers. Merged with the built-in defaults defined in ``vllm.ray.ray_env`` (PYTHONHASHSEED). Example: "MY_SECRET,MY_FLAG"

rows.name: VLLM_DCP_Q_REPLICATE
rows.description: Opt-in MLA DCP query replication: skip the decode query all-gather.

rows.name: VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND
rows.description: Flashinfer fused allreduce backend.

rows.name: VLLM_MQ_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES_MB
rows.description: Control the max chunk bytes (in MB) for the rpc message queue. Object larger than this threshold will be broadcast to worker processes via zmq.

rows.name: VLLM_LOOPBACK_IP
rows.description: Used to force set up loopback IP

rows.name: VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM
rows.description: Whether to use pytorch symmetric memory for allreduce

rows.name: VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER
rows.description: Whether to use FlashInfer allreduce

rows.name: VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER_PCIE_IPC
rows.description: Whether to use FlashInfer's single-node PCIe CUDA-IPC all-reduce. This backend has a strict single-stream contract and is opt-in while its integration is being qualified.

rows.name: VLLM_DBO_COMM_SMS
rows.parse_default:
"64"
            if hasattr(__import__("torch").version, "hip")
            and __import__("torch").version.hip is not None
            else "20"
rows.description: The number of SMs/CUs to allocate for communication kernels when running DBO; the rest will be allocated to compute. Default: 20 on CUDA (SMs), 64 on ROCm (CUs).

rows.name: VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM
rows.description: Flag to enable NCCL symmetric memory allocation and registration

rows.name: VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A
rows.description: Direct DCP ops default on when applicable; set to 1 to enforce or 0 to disable.

rows.name: VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE
rows.description: Path to the cache for storing downloaded assets

rows.name: VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE_MODEL_CLEAN
rows.description: If the env var is set, we will clean model file in this path $VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE/model_streamer/$model_name

rows.name: VLLM_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Timeout for fetching images when serving multimodal models Default is 5 seconds

rows.name: VLLM_VIDEO_FETCH_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Timeout for fetching videos when serving multimodal models Default is 30 seconds

rows.name: VLLM_AUDIO_FETCH_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Timeout for fetching audio when serving multimodal models Default is 10 seconds

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_CACHE
rows.description: Directory for caching media downloads (images, video, audio fetched from URLs during inference). Empty string disables caching.

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_CACHE_MAX_SIZE_MB
rows.description: Maximum cache size in MB. When exceeded, least-recently-used entries are evicted. Default is 5120 (5 GB).

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
rows.description: Time-to-live in hours for cached media files. Entries older than this are evicted regardless of cache size. Default is 24 hours.

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_FETCH_MAX_RETRIES
rows.description: Maximum number of retries for fetching media (images, audio, video) from URLs. Each retry quadruples the timeout. Default is 3.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_MB
rows.description: Maximum size in MB for a single remote media download. The limit is enforced while streaming the response body so oversized or infinite responses cannot grow the API server heap without bound. Default is 256.

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_URL_ALLOW_REDIRECTS
rows.description: Whether to allow HTTP redirects when fetching from media URLs. Default to True

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_LOADING_THREAD_COUNT
rows.description: Max number of workers for the thread pool handling media bytes loading. Set to 1 to disable parallel processing. Default is 8

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_CLIP_FILESIZE_MB
rows.description: Maximum filesize in MB for a single audio file. Enforced on all audio inputs (multimodal chat, speech-to-text uploads, data: URLs, and local file:// paths). Files larger than this will be rejected before decoding. Default is 25 MB.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_DECODE_DURATION_S
rows.description: Maximum decoded audio duration in seconds. Compressed audio files (e.g. OPUS at very low bitrate) can expand into gigabytes of float32 PCM. This limit is enforced *during* decoding so the memory is never allocated. Default is 600s (10 minutes).

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_DECODE_BYTES
rows.description: Maximum float32 PCM bytes that audio decoding may allocate. Guards against sample-rate forgery where an attacker inflates the header sample rate to bypass the duration guard while the actual frame count still causes a multi-GiB allocation. Default is 256 MiB (sufficient for 600s mono 48 kHz float32).

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_EMBED_DECODE_BYTES
rows.description: Maximum bytes a client-supplied embedding payload (`prompt_embeds`, `image_embeds`, `audio_embeds`, `video_embeds`) may allocate once it is densified. A sparse tensor carries its own declared shape, so a payload of a few hundred bytes can expand into hundreds of GiB. The limit is checked before `to_dense()` so the memory is never allocated. Set to 0 to …

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_PREPROCESS_WORKERS
rows.description: Maximum number of worker threads used for STT preprocessing. The default intentionally caps at 2 because that performed best in profiling. https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44612#issuecomment-4662757781

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
rows.description: Maximum decoded image size in pixels. Small compressed images can expand into gigabytes of raster memory. This limit is enforced before decoding so the memory is never allocated. Default matches PIL's built-in 2x decompression-bomb threshold (~179M pixels, ~680 MB RGB).

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_MEDIA_REQUEST_DECODE_BYTES
rows.description: Maximum aggregate decoded bytes across media in one request. The default allows one image at the per-image pixel limit at 4 bytes per pixel. Set to 0 to disable.

rows.name: VLLM_VIDEO_LOADER_BACKEND
rows.description: Backend for Video IO — selects the frame-sampling algorithm. - "opencv": uniform sampling. - "opencv_dynamic": duration-aware dynamic sampling.

rows.name: VLLM_MEDIA_CONNECTOR
rows.description: Media connector implementation. - "http": Default connector that supports fetching media via HTTP.

rows.name: VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_CACHE_DIR
rows.description: a local directory to look in for unrecognized LoRA adapters. only works if plugins are enabled and VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING is enabled.

rows.name: VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_HF_REPO_LIST
rows.description: A remote HF repo(s) containing one or more LoRA adapters, which may be downloaded and leveraged as needed. Only works if plugins are enabled and VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING is enabled. Values should be comma separated.

rows.name: VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING
rows.description: If set, allow loading or unloading lora adapters in runtime,

rows.name: VLLM_LORA_DISABLE_PDL
rows.description: Disable PDL for LoRA, as enabling PDL with LoRA on SM100 causes Triton compilation to fail.

rows.name: VLLM_LORA_ENABLE_DUAL_STREAM
rows.description: Whether to enable dual cuda streams for LoRA computation (used by both BaseLinearLayerWithLoRA and FusedMoEWithLoRA to overlap the base layer compute with the LoRA fast path).

rows.name: VLLM_V1_USE_OUTLINES_CACHE
rows.description: Whether to turn on the outlines cache for V1 This cache is unbounded and on disk, so it's not safe to use in an environment with potentially malicious users.

rows.name: VLLM_XGRAMMAR_CACHE_MB
rows.description: Control the cache sized used by the xgrammar compiler. The default of 512 MB should be enough for roughly 1000 JSON schemas. It can be changed with this variable if needed for some reason.

rows.name: VLLM_REGEX_COMPILATION_TIMEOUT_S
rows.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for regex compilation in structured output backends (xgrammar, outlines). Prevents ReDoS attacks where adversarial patterns cause exponential DFA state-space explosion. Set to 0 to disable the timeout (not recommended in production).

rows.name: VLLM_TOOL_PARSE_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
rows.description: Regex timeout for use by the vLLM tool parsing plugins.

rows.name: VLLM_ENFORCE_STRICT_TOOL_CALLING
rows.description: Enforce function parameter schemas in structural-tag based tool calling.

rows.name: VLLM_BEAM_ALWAYS_CONSTRAIN_OUTPUT
rows.description: Constrain every `beam` output to its response template's format, also without tool or structured output constraints.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSER_CONTEXT
rows.description: Experimental: use this to enable MCP tool calling for non harmony models

rows.name: VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS
rows.description: Valid values are container,code_interpreter,web_search_preview ex VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS=container,code_interpreter If the server_label of your mcp tool is not in this list it will be completely ignored.

rows.name: VLLM_TOOL_JSON_ERROR_AUTOMATIC_RETRY
rows.description: Enable automatic retry when tool call JSON parsing fails If enabled, returns an error message to the model to retry If disabled (default), raises an exception and fails the request

rows.name: VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT
rows.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds allowed for a single chat template render. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

rows.name: VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_FUEL
rows.description: Maximum template instructions (MiniJinja fuel) for rendering a request-supplied chat template (--trust-request-chat-template) in the Rust frontend; the server's own template has no limit. Set to 0 to disable the limit.

rows.name: VLLM_API_KEY
rows.description: API key for vLLM API server

rows.name: VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE
rows.description: Timeout in seconds for keeping HTTP connections alive in API server

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_N_SEQUENCES
rows.description: Maximum allowed value for the `n` sampling parameter (number of output sequences per request). Limits resource consumption to prevent denial-of-service via excessively large fan-out. Default: 16384.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_COMPLETION_PROMPTS
rows.description: Maximum number of prompts allowed in a single /v1/completions request when the prompt field is a list. Prevents unbounded fan-out of engine requests from a single API call. Default: 1024.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_STOP_STRINGS
rows.description: Maximum number of stop strings allowed in a single request.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_NUM_BAD_WORDS
rows.description: Maximum number of bad-word token sequences generated per request.

rows.name: VLLM_MAX_BAD_WORDS_TOTAL_TOKENS
rows.description: Maximum total number of bad-word tokens (summed across all bad words) allowed per request. Bounds the per-request GPU buffer width.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND
rows.description: If set, use the Rust frontend binary instead of the Python API server process(es).

rows.name: VLLM_USE_RUST_BENCH
rows.description: If set, use the packaged Rust client for `vllm bench serve`.

rows.name: VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH
rows.description: Path to the vllm-rs binary. Defaults to "auto" which discovers the binary installed with the vllm package. Used when VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 or VLLM_USE_RUST_BENCH=1.

rows.name: VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE
rows.description: If set, vllm will run in development mode, which will enable some additional endpoints for developing and debugging, e.g. `/reset_prefix_cache`

rows.name: VLLM_MSGPACK_ZERO_COPY_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Control the threshold for msgspec to use 'zero copy' for serialization/deserialization of tensors. Tensors below this limit will be encoded into the msgpack buffer, and tensors above will instead be sent via a separate message. While the sending side still actually copies the tensor in all cases, on the receiving side, tensors above this limit will actually …

rows.name: VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION
rows.description: If set, allow insecure serialization using pickle. This is useful for environments where it is deemed safe to use the insecure method and it is needed for some reason.

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLE_REQUEST_ID_RANDOMIZATION
rows.description: Temporary: skip adding random suffix to internal request IDs. May be needed for KV connectors that match request IDs across instances.

rows.name: VLLM_PROCESS_NAME_PREFIX
rows.description: Used to set the process name prefix for vLLM processes. This is useful for debugging and monitoring purposes. The default value is "VLLM".

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_RESPONSES_API_STORE
rows.description: Enables support for the "store" option in the OpenAI Responses API. When set to 1, vLLM's OpenAI server will retain the input and output messages for those requests in memory. By default, this is disabled (0), and the "store" option is ignored. NOTE/WARNING: 1. Messages are kept in memory only (not persisted to disk) and will be lost when the vLLM server …

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_COHERE_API
rows.description: If set to 1, expose the Cohere Chat v2 API at ``POST /cohere/v2/chat`` and its render endpoint at ``POST /cohere/v2/chat/render``. Default off

rows.name: VLLM_GPT_OSS_HARMONY_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS
rows.description: Allows harmony instructions to be injected on system messages

rows.name: VLLM_SYSTEM_START_DATE
rows.description: Pin the conversation start date injected into the Harmony system message. When unset the current date is used, which introduces non-determinism (different tokens -> different model behaviour at temperature=0). Set to an ISO date string, e.g. "2023-09-12", for reproducible inference or testing.

rows.name: VLLM_SKIP_MODEL_NAME_VALIDATION
rows.description: Skip model name validation in OpenAI API requests. When set to 1, any model name will be accepted in the 'model' field of API requests. This is useful for proxy/gateway scenarios where the actual model is served but different names may be used in requests.

rows.name: VLLM_CACHE_ROOT
rows.description: Root directory for vLLM cache files Defaults to `~/.cache/vllm` unless `XDG_CACHE_HOME` is set

rows.name: VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE
rows.description: If true, will load models from ModelScope instead of Hugging Face Hub.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS
rows.description: If true, replace the Rust BPE backend that powers HF fast tokenizers with the `fastokens` (https://github.com/crusoecloud/fastokens) shim. Applies to any tokenizer mode that loads an HF fast tokenizer (`hf`, `deepseek_v32`, `deepseek_v4`, …). The `fastokens` Python package must be installed.

rows.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
rows.description: S3 access information, used for tensorizer to load model from S3

rows.name: VLLM_FASTSAFETENSORS_QUEUE_SIZE
rows.description: Queue size for fastsafetensors ParallelLoader pipelined weight loading. Peak load-time VRAM is roughly model_weights + (1 + queue_size) * shard_size. Default 0 preserves the non-pipelined memory footprint so this change does not shrink the loadable-model envelope. Set to 1 (or higher) to overlap producing the next shard's device buffer with the consumer …

rows.name: VLLM_PLUGINS
rows.description: a list of plugin names to load, separated by commas. if this is not set, it means all plugins will be loaded if this is set to an empty string, no plugins will be loaded

rows.name: VLLM_MODEL_REDIRECT_PATH
rows.description: Use model_redirect to redirect the model name to a local folder. `model_redirect` can be a json file mapping the model between repo_id and local folder: {"meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B": "/tmp/Llama-3.2-1B"} or a space separated values table file: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B /tmp/Llama-3.2-1B

rows.name: VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER
rows.description: User override folder for tuned Triton-kernel configs. Shared by MoE, Mamba SSU, and LoRA. Filenames are distinct so one folder can hold all. Each component first checks this folder, then the configs shipped with vLLM (if any). If no JSON matches, it uses a hard-coded heuristic.

rows.name: VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_PIN_MEMORY
rows.description: Disable using pytorch's pin memory for CPU offloading.

rows.name: VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_UVA
rows.description: Disable using UVA (Unified Virtual Addressing) for CPU offloading.

rows.name: VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY
rows.description: On WSL2 with a compatible kernel (>= 4.19.121), pinned memory is supported but disabled by default due to a small performance regression. Set to 1 when pinned memory or UVA is required (e.g. CPU offloading or v2 model runner).

rows.name: VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER
rows.description: Whether to use the FlashInfer top-k / top-p sampler on CUDA. Enabled by default when the hardware supports it — set to 0 to opt out explicitly, which forces the PyTorch-native (Triton for bs>=8) path.

rows.name: VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB
rows.description: Maximum size (in MB) for logits tensor in sparse MLA indexer prefill chunks. Bounds the [M, N] float32 logits tensor to prevent CUDA OOM. Default: 512 MB

rows.name: VLLM_ADAPTIVE_VERIFICATION_PROFILE_CONTEXT_LEN
rows.description: KV context length each adaptive-verification profiling request pretends to carry, so the profiled step reads a realistic amount of cache. Raise it for long-context deployments, where step cost is dominated by attention over a much larger KV cache than the default assumes. Clamped to max_model_len - query_len. Default: 8192 tokens

rows.name: VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ
rows.description: If set, vLLM will use Triton implementations of AWQ.

rows.name: VLLM_TRITON_FORCE_FIRST_CONFIG
rows.description: If set, monkey-patch triton.runtime.autotuner.Autotuner.run to skip benchmarking and select the first valid config (walking past invalid ones). Used to eliminate autotuning variability when measuring kernel performance and applied before running any kernel.

rows.name: VLLM_TRITON_JIT_WARMUP_NUM_THREADS
rows.description: Maximum compiler threads per worker for registered CUDA Triton JIT warmup. Set to 1 for serial warmup. Does not affect runtime JIT or autotuning.

rows.name: VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS
rows.description: List of quantization kernels that should be disabled, used for testing and performance comparisons. Currently only affects MPLinearKernel selection (kernels: MacheteLinearKernel, MarlinLinearKernel, ExllamaLinearKernel)

rows.name: VLLM_USE_HW_AGNOSTIC
rows.description: Selects hw-agnostic layers for HF transformer backend

rows.name: VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL
rows.description: Select the GDN MTP decode implementation. "cuda" uses the fused decode kernel where supported and falls back to "triton" otherwise; setting it explicitly to "cuda" raises when unsupported.

rows.name: VLLM_USE_OINK_OPS
rows.description: Optional: enable external Oink custom ops (e.g., Blackwell RMSNorm). Disabled by default.

rows.name: VLLM_MXFP4_EMULATION_DEQUANT_AT_LOAD
rows.description: Disable aiter ops unless specifically enabled. Acts as a parent switch to enable the rest of the other operations. Set to 1 to dequantize MXFP4 weights to BF16 once at load time and run as a BF16 checkpoint (no per-step weight dequant). This improves emulation latency at the cost of additional device memory. Default off.

rows.name: VLLM_MXFP8_EMULATION_DEQUANT_AT_LOAD
rows.description: On hardware without a native MXFP8 kernel (e.g. ROCm gfx942 / MI300), the MXFP8 emulation path dequantizes weights MXFP8->BF16 once at load time and runs as a BF16 checkpoint (no per-step dequant). Set to 0 to fall back to per-step dequant: keeps the 1-byte MXFP8 weights (~half the weight memory) at the cost of dequantizing every forward step (much slower). …

rows.name: VLLM_USE_LAYERNAME
rows.description: If set to "0", disable LayerName opaque type for layer_name parameters in custom ops. Defaults to enabled on torch >= 2.11.

rows.name: VLLM_MLA_DISABLE
rows.description: If set, vLLM will disable the MLA attention optimizations.

rows.name: VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD
rows.description: Whether to use atomicAdd reduce in gptq/awq marlin kernel.

rows.name: VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE
rows.description: The activation dtype for marlin kernel

rows.name: VLLM_HUMMING_ONLINE_QUANT_CONFIG
rows.description: The online quantization dtype for humming kernel

rows.name: VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG
rows.description: The activation dtype config for humming kernel. Explicit schemas disable fallback unless the config includes "allow_fallback": true.

rows.name: VLLM_HUMMING_USE_F16_ACCUM
rows.description: Whether to use fp16 accumulator mma

rows.name: VLLM_KIMI_K3_AUX_ATTN_RES_STREAM
rows.description: Kimi K3 only, and unrelated to the MoE flags above. Tap the pre-norm AttnRes mixture, rather than the post-mixture sum, as the auxiliary hidden state handed to a DFlash drafter. This changes the numerics the speculator sees, so it is off by default while the effect is measured.

rows.name: VLLM_KIMI_K3_GEMM_AR
rows.description: Use the SM100 BF16 GEMM-AR kernel for eligible Kimi-K3 row-parallel attention projections. All TP ranks must belong to one NVLink domain.

rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS
rows.description: Fuse eligible sequence-parallel row-parallel projections with their TP reduce-scatter using the SM100 BF16/MXFP8 GEMM-RS kernel (Kimi-K3 attention/shared-expert projections, DeepSeek-V4.1 ``wo_b``). All TP ranks must belong to one NVLink domain.

rows.name: VLLM_BLOCKSCALE_FP8_GEMM_FLASHINFER
rows.description: Allow use of FlashInfer FP8 block-scale GEMM for linear layers. This uses TensorRT-LLM kernels and requires SM90+ (Hopper).

rows.name: VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR
rows.description: Override the directory for the FlashInfer autotune config cache.

rows.name: VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_SKIP_OPS
rows.description: Comma-separated FlashInfer op names to exclude from autotuning, using the heuristic fallback tactic instead. Unset: skip "fp4_gemm" when the CuTe-DSL NVFP4 linear kernel is selected. Empty: skip nothing.

rows.name: VLLM_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BUFFER_SIZE
rows.description: Control the workspace buffer size for the FlashInfer backend.

rows.name: VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT
rows.description: KV Cache layout used throughout vllm. Some common values are: - LBNHC - LBHNC Where N=num_states, H=num_heads and C=state_content. The default value will leave the layout choice to the backend. Mind that backends may only implement and support a subset of all possible layouts. LHBNC hoists the head dim outside the block dim; backends must opt in via …

rows.name: VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT
rows.description: SSM conv state layout used for Mamba models. - SD: (state_len, dim) — dim contiguous (default) - DS: (dim, state_len) — TP-sharded dim on dim1, consistent with SSM temporal state and LBHNC KV cache layout.

rows.name: VLLM_ALLOW_CHUNKED_LOCAL_ATTN_WITH_HYBRID_KV_CACHE
rows.description: Allow chunked local attention with hybrid kv cache manager. Currently using the Hybrid KV cache manager with chunked local attention in the Llama4 models (the only models currently using chunked local attn) causes a latency regression. rows.name: VLLM_MULTI_STREAM_GEMM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Token-count cutoff for multi-stream overlap of the attention input GEMM with auxiliary GEMMs (e.g. fused_wqa_wkv overlapped with indexer weights / kv-score projections in DeepSeek-V4). rows.name: VLLM_ENABLE_HPC_OPS
rows.description: If set to 1, enable the HPC fused kernels (requires the hpc package (.so) and an sm100/sm103 device). Covers: * the HY V4 iHC ops -- each of the eager HYV4HCPreLayer / HYV4HCPostLayer / HYV4HCHeadLayer bodies becomes one kernel launch; * the gated-MLA output gating (attn_out * sigmoid(gate projection)), fused into gated_mla_gemm; elementwise gating only. …

rows.name: VLLM_SKIP_VERSION_SUFFIX
rows.description: Whether to skip version suffix when building package
